Name: Seasonal Berries
Author: BasiliskL
Description:
All vanilla "berries" have a chance of appearing on the bushes throughout the seasons they are normally available.

Ancient Fruit, Coffee Bean, and Sweet Gem Berry available as config option with very low chances.

Will be adding optional files for berries from other mods I play with. If I miss a berry or something you think should be included then let me know.
